thought.text: DNS doesn't resolve `*.localhost` in this sandbox. Let me test using `--resolve`:

reasoning_content: curl exit code 6 = couldn't resolve host. "api.localhost" can't be resolved by the container's DNS (169.254.1.1 / 192.168.127.1). This sandbox's DNS doesn't have the *.localhost → 127.0.0.1 mapping. Let's test with the Host header against 127.0.0.1:443 using --resolve.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== API root ===\"; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://api.localhost/ -w \"\\nHTTP %{http_code}\\n\" | head -c 500; echo \"=== API v1 ===\"; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://api.localhost/api/v1/ -w \"\\nHTTP %{http_code}\\n\" | head -c 500", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}
